commands.author: Pick-cat

target.title: fix(ai): keep OpenAI tool call id truncation UTF-16 safe
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

`normalizeToolCallId` in `openai-completions.ts:1052` truncates oversized OpenAI tool call IDs with `id.slice(0, 40)`. When a tool call ID contains a UTF-16 surrogate pair straddling positions 39-40, `slice` splits the pair and leaves an unpaired high surrogate at position 39 — producing invalid Unicode in the outbound API request.

## Why This Change Was Made

`String.prototype.slice(0, 40)` operates on UTF-16 code units, not Unicode characters. A surrogate pair (e.g. 🐱 `\uD83D\uDC31`) consumes 2 code units. When the cut falls between the high and low surrogates, the result is invalid Unicode that downstream consumers (OpenAI API, JSON encoders, database storage) may reject.

The fix switches from `id.slice(0, 40)` to `truncateUtf16Safe(id, 40)` from `@openclaw/normalization-core/utf16-slice`, an existing repo helper already used across the codebase for safe UTF-16 boundary truncation.

## Evidence Map

| Layer | Detail |
|-------|--------|
| **Changed surface** | `normalizeToolCallId` in `packages/ai/src/providers/openai-completions.ts:1052` — one line |
| **Fix** | `id.slice(0, 40)` → `truncateUtf16Safe(id, 40)` |
| **Sibling UTF-16 fix PRs** | #104054, #107664, #109561, #109498, #109839 — same helper, different surfaces |
| **Callers** | `convertMessages` → `streamOpenAICompletions` — cross-model tool-call path |
| **Test** | `openai-completions.test.ts` — 47/47 pass; new test with 41-code-unit 🐱 surrogate pair at boundary |
| **Mutation proof** | Reverting to `slice` makes the surrogate test fail with `trailing high surrogate: true` |
| **Before/after proof** | Terminal output below — `slice` produces `�` (invalid); `truncateUtf16Safe` drops both surrogates |

### Behavioral proof (terminal output)

```text
=== UTF-16 safe tool call id truncation proof ===

Input:    "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa🐱"
          length=41 code units

BEFORE (slice(0,40)):
  "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa�"
  length=40
  trailing high surrogate: true  ← BROKEN

AFTER (truncateUtf16Safe):
  "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa"
  length=39
  trailing high surrogate: false
  prefix preserved: true

PASS: no unpaired surrogate in output
```

### Why a live API roundtrip is not practical

The `onPayload` hook in the test intercepts the exact JSON payload before `fetch` — the same bytes the API would receive. A live API call requires an active OpenAI key and is non-deterministic (rate limits, network). The test validates the `tool_call_id` field in that captured payload directly, which is stronger evidence than a live roundtrip.

### CI status

Rebased onto current `main` (`13ae897cfbd`). 47/47 tests pass locally. Surrogate-pair boundary test added; mutation check confirms the test catches the regression.

## User Impact

- Multi-model `openai` provider conversations with tool calls now produce valid Unicode in all tool call IDs
- No behavioral change for IDs without surrogate pairs at the boundary
- Non-OpenAI provider paths unchanged
